parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the PyYAML SafeLoader/dump behavior, ESM .mjs requirement, no external dependencies, manual --a parsing, and /output delivery target.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It assigned a workflow to broad behavior discovery across resolver, emitter, loader, argparse, and numeric dimensions, while the parent owned local module writing.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote a partial YAML implementation under /output/lib, including scanner, parser, composer, resolver, value and helper modules, but not the entry file.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact contained only lib/*.mjs files and lacked the required /output/test15.mjs entry point for the evaluator.
parallel.verification: The workflow was intended to verify probe reports, but the workflow state shows verifier agents still in progress and result null when killed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with no test15.mjs, no final response, no aggregate verifier return, and an official 0 of 152 evaluation result.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same prompt requirements for a native Node ESM PyYAML-compatible port with no external npm modules.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept exploration and implementation in the parent process with workflows and delegation disabled by the serial control.
serial.implementation: It produced more local implementation modules, including constructor, emitter, patterns, resolver, scanner, and support modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Despite more modules, the serial artifact also lacked the required /output/test15.mjs entry file and therefore was not deliverable.
serial.verification: The serial run performed local smoke checks during development but had no delegated verification or completed evaluator-aligned acceptance before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial attempt timed out, shipped no test15.mjs, and the official evaluator reported 0 of 152 passing samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had the full prompt requiring Node ESM .mjs files, manual argv handling, no external dependencies, and /output/test15.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and therefore the same delivery and behavioral obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference; both failed the shared deliverable requirement by omitting test15.mjs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavior discovery into a workflow with six probe dimensions and verifier tasks while the parent wrote modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all exploration and implementation local, with no workflow calls, no delegation, and no child logs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a broad multi-agent research and verification structure; serial used a single-actor implementation path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs asked for prose findings and evidence tables, explicitly not implementation code, creating research handoffs for later parent integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child briefs or handoff interfaces; the same actor retained implementation context directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent information transfer through probe and verifier reports, while serial avoided cross-agent interface risk entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a partial library set including parser, scanner, resolver, values, and helpers but no entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a larger local library set including constructor, emitter, patterns, pyvalues, and helpers but also no entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial advanced more of the implementation surface locally; parallel spent more work on behavioral probing and shipped fewer implementation modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow entered Verify, started verifier children, but was killed with result null and no aggregate verifier return to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its lifecycle problem was local timeout before final entry-file delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished child-result lifecycle, whereas serial's unfinished state was not a delegation lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation copied a larger lib/*.mjs set but also found no expected entry file; no shared-write collision existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed final assembly; parallel did not show a shared-state race, while serial had no concurrent shared state by design.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned adversarial verification after probes but the workflow was killed before verifier aggregation, and the official evaluator then scored 0 of 152.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local smoke checks but no final evaluator-aligned acceptance was reached before timeout; official score was also 0 of 152.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was explicitly delegated and left incomplete; serial verification was local and incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after using workflow children and 833135 workflow child tokens, with the workflow killed and no entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but all tokens and tool calls were local, with zero workflow child tokens and no entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete parallel-only budget issue is the broad fan-out plus retries consuming finite budget; serial's budget failure was local implementation overrun.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current official evaluations completed and both reported solution_passed false with 0 of 152 samples. The concrete task-solving difference is strategic: parallel used a broad probe-and-verify workflow that was killed before aggregation and left only partial library files, while serial kept the work local and produced more modules. Neither delivered test15.mjs, so there is no official outcome difference to explain.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and verifier phase consumed substantial finite budget before final assembly.
The required test15.mjs entry file was absent from the parallel artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial control avoided delegation but still timed out before final assembly.
The required test15.mjs entry file was absent from the serial artifact.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial produced additional implementation modules such as constructor, emitter, patterns, pyvalues, and repr that are absent from the parallel artifact.
Parallel produced extensive behavioral research through children but fewer parent-written implementation modules.
evaluator_effects: The missing entry file makes both submissions non-deliverable; the official score cannot distinguish latent library correctness.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a realized parallel-side adverse process consequence only
